vision: Provide a unified platform for managing customers, leads, opportunities, and sales reporting.

objectives.name: Reduce sales cycle
objectives.description: Reduce the time required to move qualified opportunities to signed deals.

users.name: Sales Manager
users.description: Owns pipeline visibility and sales-team performance.

businessEntities.name: Customer
businessEntities.meaning: An organization or person with a commercial relationship.

businessEntities.name: Opportunity
businessEntities.meaning: A qualified sales possibility with expected value.

capabilities.name: Manage Customers
capabilities.description: Maintain customer records and relationship history.

capabilities.name: Track Opportunities
capabilities.description: Track opportunity stage, owner, value, and next action.

businessRules.name: Unique Customer
businessRules.description: Customer records must be uniquely identifiable.

policies.name: Audit Policy
policies.description: Changes to sales records must be auditable.

reporting.name: Pipeline Dashboard
reporting.purpose: Show pipeline value and sales progress.

quality.requirement: The system should be available during business hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Availability is measurable during business hours.

constraints.description: Customer data cannot leave the EU.
